description: Source code for the WMLMapPoint class, representing map points in the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, including initialization, encoding/decoding, and unit management.

classes.name: WMLMapPoint
classes.description: Represents a map point with terrain and units, supporting serialization and unit management.

methods.description: Default initializer, calls initWithCode:index: with 0,0.
